## Experience

### Software Development Engineer 2, Authn-SDKs — Auth0 (Okta)
July 2024 – Present | Bangalore, India

Primary maintainer of nextjs-auth0 (21M+ monthly downloads, 141% growth in tenure).

- Shipped full MFA step-up support for Next.js SDK — first server-side Auth0 SDK with this capability. Design to production in 5 weeks.
- Rewired SDK from single-domain to dynamic per-request domain resolution. Zero breaking changes, sessions auto-migrate.
- Built and shipped auth0-hono: new authentication SDK for the Hono framework. 8,100+ lines of code, 291 tests, runs on Node, Cloudflare Workers, Deno, and Bun. Gap analysis to shipping in 4 weeks.
- Delivered DPoP (proof-of-possession tokens), token exchange, and organization-scoped auth across Next.js, SPA, and Node SDKs. Cut 31 releases across 3 packages in 16 months.
- Patched critical Next.js cache poisoning vulnerability affecting all Next.js users globally across Auth0 SDK ecosystem.
- Authored 15+ design docs adopted across teams. Proposed and got approval for 10+ architecture decisions in cross-team reviews.

### Software Development Engineer 1, B2B-Subscriptions — ZEE5
August 2022 – July 2024 | Bangalore, India

Scaling video streaming platform for 65M+ monthly active users.

- Built Mirage: high-throughput token exchange service handling 4,000 req/sec for 40M+ B2B users (60% of ZEE5's revenue base).
- Led zero-downtime AWS to GCP migration including PostgreSQL to Cloud Spanner for 5M+ daily auth events. Cut DB latency to under 10ms.
- Built async subscription orchestrator with automatic failover. 99.9% uptime on revenue-critical B2B flows.
- Moved Node.js services to Java WebFlux. 10x throughput, zero regressions, zero customer-facing downtime.

### Forge: AI Development Workflow Engine
Technologies: Claude, TypeScript, State Machines

Multi-phase AI orchestrator that automates the full software lifecycle: requirements, design, implementation, review, and documentation. Used to ship two major SDK features (MFA and Multi-Domain). Adopted by team for AI-assisted development.

### LightRAW: AI-Powered Photo Editing Pipeline
Technologies: Claude, RawTherapee, Git, Batch Processing

Prompt-driven RAW photo editing system. Describe edits in plain English, apply across hundreds of files automatically. Replaces complex multi-tool workflows (exposure, color grading, noise reduction) with a single conversational interface backed by professional-grade RAW processors.

### OPAL: Real-time Log Analytics (Auth0 Hackathon Finalist)
Technologies: ClickHouse, S3, Benthos, Cube.js

Analytics engine ingesting 13k events/sec for customer usage insights. Estimated $70k/month savings over existing solution. Column-oriented storage with 130:1 write-read efficiency.
